d: Chestnut brown hair is parted to the side with a long braid resting over the left shoulder. Golden-amber eyes are narrow and focused, set on a youthful face with a mature expression. The build is slender and athletic. The outfit consists of a red cape held by a gold brooch, a dark metallic cuirass with gold trim, a red and white pteruges skirt, a red fabric wrap on the right wrist, and a white armored gauntlet on the left arm, complemented by gold greaves over brown strappy sandals. A brown hawk is perched on the right hand, and a spear and quiver of arrows are carried.
